releaseNotes: V982 adds a deterministic structural repair for genuinely missing mandatory AI response sections after V981 confirmed that the local model can omit Conclusion or Confirmed facts entirely.

Only the mandatory Conclusion and Confirmed facts sections are eligible for repair. Their content is generated exclusively from the already-completed ICEops Deterministic Evaluation and cited to the deterministic Evidence packet; Analysis, causes, thresholds, baselines, trends, and health classifications are never synthesized.

A repaired response is immediately revalidated by the unchanged AiGroundingValidator. Up to two mandatory-section repairs are allowed so an answer missing both Conclusion and Confirmed facts can be repaired sequentially; any remaining semantic, citation, evidence, trend, criteria, or format failure keeps the AI explanation BLOCKED.

V980 VERDICT repair, V979 No-Criteria semantic neutralization, V981 localized heading canonicalization, deterministic evaluation, Safe Disconnect, communication, Polling/MAX, PDO/ISDU, Studio Runtime, HMI read-only, AI Data Library, and Signal Tower hardware-control paths remain unchanged.

en: Added deterministic repair for genuinely missing mandatory Conclusion and Confirmed facts sections.
Trusted repair text is derived only from ICEops Deterministic Evaluation and is fully revalidated by the unchanged Grounding validator.
No Analysis, cause, threshold, baseline, trend, or health judgment is synthesized; unresolved failures remain BLOCKED.
ko: 실제로 누락된 필수 [결론] 및 [확인된 사실] 섹션을 결정론적으로 복구하는 처리를 추가했습니다.
복구 문장은 ICEops Deterministic Evaluation에서만 생성하고 기존 Grounding Validator로 전체 재검증합니다.
분석/원인/Threshold/Baseline/Trend/Health 판정은 생성하지 않으며 남은 검증 실패는 계속 BLOCKED 처리합니다.
ja: 実際に欠落した必須の Conclusion / Confirmed facts セクションを決定論的に補修する処理を追加しました。
補修文は ICEops Deterministic Evaluation のみから生成し、既存 Grounding Validator で全体を再検証します。
Analysis、原因、Threshold、Baseline、Trend、Health 判定は生成せず、残る検証失敗は引き続き BLOCKED です。
zh-CN: 增加了对真正缺失的必需 Conclusion / Confirmed facts 章节进行确定性修复的处理。
修复文本只从 ICEops Deterministic Evaluation 生成，并由现有 Grounding Validator 对完整响应重新验证。
不会生成 Analysis、原因、Threshold、Baseline、Trend 或 Health 判断；剩余验证失败仍保持 BLOCKED。
de: Eine deterministische Reparatur für tatsächlich fehlende Pflichtabschnitte Conclusion und Confirmed facts wurde ergänzt.
Der Reparaturtext wird ausschließlich aus der ICEops Deterministic Evaluation erzeugt und anschließend vollständig durch den unveränderten Grounding Validator geprüft.
Analyse, Ursachen, Thresholds, Baselines, Trends oder Health-Bewertungen werden nicht synthetisiert; verbleibende Fehler bleiben BLOCKED.
es: Se añadió una reparación determinista para las secciones obligatorias Conclusion y Confirmed facts cuando faltan realmente.
El texto reparado se genera únicamente desde ICEops Deterministic Evaluation y se vuelve a validar por completo con el Grounding Validator sin cambios.
No se sintetizan análisis, causas, thresholds, baselines, tendencias ni juicios de salud; cualquier fallo restante continúa BLOCKED.
